jobs.description:
Associate Director, Clinical Research Scientist

We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

Back to search results

Previous job Next job

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

AD, Clinical Research Scientist

The AD, CRS supports Clinical Strategy.

Responsibilities

• 

• Serve as a key role in the effective implementation of the global development strategy leading or co-leading one or more clinical trials in a therapeutic area for one or more compounds in various stages of clinical development (including clinical trial implementation, and oversight of all aspects of clinical development) working closely with the Medical Director and other cross-functions to provide high-quality and timely deliverables

• Contribute to the development of the program strategy for assigned trials/compounds and participate in the development of the clinical development plan (CDP)

• Author components with Medical Director and reviewer of clinical and regulatory documents and registration dossiers (i.e., protocol, ICF, IB, safety updates, study reports, regulatory submissions, etc.) to support registration and commercialization of the compound(s)

• Participate in the development of case report forms (eCRFs), eCRFs completion guidelines, and provide scientific support for other key data management deliverables (e.g. database lock activities)

• Lead the development of medical data review plan (MDRP), perform ongoing data review, and summarize efficacy and safety data for interpretation/analysis

• Provide medical input for country/site selection, feasibility assessment and engage in KOL interaction

• Prepare charters and coordinate internal/external committee meetings including presentation preparation (i.e., Dose Escalation, DMC, Steering Committee, Safety)

• Participate in the development and review of study plans and serve as a liaison to project teams and CROs

• Prepare presentations for Investigator meetings, CRO/CRA training, SIVs as warranted

• Provide input for the development of publications in coordination with Scientific Communications

• Guide and mentor junior level Clinical Research Scientists

Qualifications

• 

• PhD, Pharm D, MS or equivalent degree preferably within the medical, biological, pharmaceutical science or related discipline

• Minimum requirement: 8+ years of experience in clinical research with at least 4 or more years of drug development experience (preferably in oncology/hematology)

• Significant experience working in a project-oriented matrixed team environment

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

• Proven experience working in teams

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic and goal orientated

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK730.320,00---1.095.480,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

_Are you passionate about ensuring complex IoT and connectivity solutions perform reliably before reaching customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of system architecture, embedded firmware, verification, and AI? And do you want to help shape the future of verification and validation for connected products in a modern engineering organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Test Manager, Connectivity Solutions, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, performance, and release readiness of our connectivity products, embedded firmware, and integrated solutions.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, Firmware Developers, and Hardware Engineers, you will drive verification activities across disciplines and help shape the future of testing within the Water Division.

More specifically, you will be:

• Defining and driving the verification strategy throughout the product lifecycle

• Leading verification activities across firmware, hardware, connectivity, and integrated solutions

• Ensuring traceability, test coverage, and alignment from requirements to release readiness

• Driving AI-enabled verification, test automation, and modern quality engineering practices

• Building and strengthening the capabilities, processes, and governance supporting the future test organization within the Water Division

Combine hands-on technical impact with strategic influence as you drive verification excellence, shape future testing practices, and help bring innovative connected solutions safely to market.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting to the Director of Connectivity, you will join the Solutions Architect team within the Water Division. Working alongside specialists in connectivity, embedded systems, wireless communication, system architecture, and product development, you will help ensure our solutions are verified and validated before release.

You will be part of an informal and collaborative environment characterized by strong technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and a shared commitment to delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Test Manager who thrives in complex engineering environments and brings structure, quality, and continuous improvement to the verification of connected solutions. Combining analytical thinking with a pragmatic approach, you are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and driving quality through collaboration, automation, and emerging technologies.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, and have experience testing embedded, firmware-based, connected, or IoT products

• Understand systems integration, and acceptance testing and can develop effective verification strategies and test plans from product requirements and used cases

• Have hands-on experience with Python, embedded C, test automation, and embedded systems debugging

• Collaborate effectively across hardware, firmware, connectivity, and software domains with both specialists and project stakeholders

• Take ownership, communicate clearly, and drive continuous improvements through automation, AI-enabled verification, and modern quality engineering

Experience with wireless communication technologies, Grafana, test management tools, requirements management, systems engineering practices, or AI-assisted verification is considered an advantage.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director, Connectivity, Kristen Kasper Hansen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Help shape operational excellence across our global logistics network

Do you want to help create smarter, more connected and future-ready logistics operations across Arla?

In this senior leadership role, you will play a key part in shaping operational excellence across our global logistics network. Working closely with colleagues across sites, markets and central functions, you will help translate strategy into practical standards, processes and solutions while strengthening the capabilities needed to support consistent and sustainable operational performance.

“You will lead our Operational Excellence team and  collaborate closely with logistics sites, market teams and central functions. Together, you will develop, test and embed solutions across both insourced- and outsourced operations,” says Jakob Hartvig, Head of Center of Excellence – Logistics.

How you will make an impact

As Head of Operational Excellence in Logistics CoE, you will help connect global ambition with local execution. You will inspire and provide functional leadership across the logistics network, create clarity on priorities and responsibilities, and work with stakeholders to ensure that improvements  create meaningful and measurable operational value.

In this role you will:

• Shape and drive the global strategy and long-term roadmap for logistics operational excellence, aligning priorities and resources across sites, markets and functions.

• Define, implement and continuously improve common logistics standards, SOPs, playbooks and process taxonomy, while strengthening continuous improvement capabilities through approaches such as Lean, A3 and PDCA.

• Develop  and embed the Arla Performance System for logistics, including performance meeting standards, operational KPIs, dashboards, benchmarking and links to financial performance and the SQCDMP balanced scorecard.

• Further advance on the digital transformation of logistics by identifying, assessing and scaling high-value use cases across AI, machine learning, IoT, automation and other smart logistics technologies.

Foster a strong operational excellence network across Arla, by supporting capability building,  change adoption while drawing on external insights and proof-of-concept activities.

What  will help you succeed

You bring  experience within operational excellence, continuous improvement,  logistics transformation or a related field, and you are motivated by creating sustainable improvements in complex environments . You are comfortable working across organizational and geographical boundaries and understand the importance of balancing global consistency with local needs.

You combine strategic thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy engaging with diverse stakeholders to create solutions that work in practice.

We imagine that you bring:

• Relevant experience within operational excellence, supply chain, logistics

• A degree in Economics, Supply Chain or related field or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and data-driven performance management frameworks.

• Experience with digital transformation, automation or smart logistics solutions. Leadership experience, either through people leadership or matrix environments

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills

As a leader, you create  direction by translating complexity into clear priorities and actionable plans. You build trust by listening and being curious, involving local market stakeholders and adapting solutions where appropriate. At the same time, you maintain focus on delivering sustainable outcomes and continuous improvements.

What do we offer?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of logistics across Arla and create impact at network scale. You will work with experienced colleagues across markets, sites and central functions, combining global perspectives with practical operational expertise. The role offers broad exposure, meaningful transformation opportunities and the chance to contribute to the development of people, processes and digital solutions that strengthen safety, quality, service, cost and sustainability performance.

We are committed to professional development and a collaborative culture where knowledge is shared and improvements are built together. You will join a farmer-owned, international business with a clear purpose and the ambition to make nutritious dairy products while continuously improving how we operate.

Would you like to join us?

Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we process applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jakob Hartvig, Head of Logistics Center of Excellence, at jakob.hartvig@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Operational Network Planner - Viby J or Krusaa
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supply chain planning within an End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Krusaa cluster.

“Joining the Krusaa Cluster Planning team, you will be part of planning the supply of speciality cheese products across a complex and dynamic supply chain. Working closely with Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help connect customer demand with production and supply. If you thrive in an operational environment, enjoy collaborating across functions and want to make a real impact, this could be the opportunity for you” says Christine Carstensen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

The role can be based either in Krusaa or Viby J. To support close collaboration with the planning team and production sites, colleagues based in Viby J are expected to spend a minimum of one day per week in Krusaa.

Read more about Supply Chain at Arla here: Inside Arla.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of 6 Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting five production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you:

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

• Are able to communicate effectively both in Danish and in English

What do we offer?

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

About Arla

We are Arla – a European dairy cooperative with over 19,000 employees and around 8,600 farmers. Our cooperative model creates a unique closeness to our farmers – the owners of Arla – and motivates us every day to deliver the very best for our farmers, colleagues, our milk, our consumers, and our environment.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions, please contact Supply Chain Network Planning Manager, Christine Carstensen at +45 91 31 58 03.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**_Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic, global environment? SimCorp offers a unique opportunity to join our finance team as a Group Transfer Pricing Director.

_For over five decades, SimCorp has been at the forefront of providing integrated investment management solutions. With a global team of over 4000 professionals from diverse backgrounds, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace.

The Group Transfer Pricing Director will be an integral part of our tax team, a specialized subset within Group Finance. Our team is responsible for overseeing the tax and transfer pricing compliance and strategy across all 40+ SimCorp entities.

Based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape SimCorp's transfer pricing strategy and ensure compliance across our global operations.

Reporting directly to the Global Head of Tax, your primary responsibility will be to lead the transfer pricing team and devise SimCorp's transfer pricing strategies. Your team will be responsible for the tax modeling, documentation, and devising transfer pricing procedures.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will play a critical role in supporting SimCorp’s global organization by providing transfer pricing solutions. Your work will involve analyzing and enhancing transfer pricing structures, ensuring compliance with global regulations, and continuously implementing improvements in our transfer pricing models.

You will be responsible for reviewing the transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries. This includes leading the team to draft reports, collect and analyze financial data, and collaborate with subsidiaries' finance teams and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and compliant reporting. We take pride in contributing to SimCorp’s growth through high-quality work. We value a collaborative working environment where we balance hard work with an approachable and collaborative spirit.

As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will:

• Devise new transfer pricing policies and update existing policies to ensure compliance with OECD guidelines and local regulations.

• Develop vision, strategy and structure of the group’s transfer pricing models in the rapidly changing environment, including APAs.

• Guide the transfer pricing team to prepare and maintain comprehensive transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries in collaboration with the finance teams.

• Review changes in global transfer pricing legislations and ensure the group’s transfer pricing models are efficient and compliant.

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, including finance, legal, and business, to ensure effective transfer pricing practices.

• Lead and manage transfer pricing projects, drive change, secure stakeholder buy-in, and ensure high-quality deliverables and outstanding results.

• Represent the group on transfer pricing audits and dispute resolution and influence decisions in complex negotiations with tax authorities globally

• Provide excellent and timely support to our business team and finance team on intercompany transactions such as transfers of intangible property, services, and loans.

• Develop a mature control framework to ensure transfer pricing documentation, returns, notifications, intercompany agreements and related deliverables are maintained.

• Collaborate closely with Group Finance, subsidiary finance teams to ensure that TP policies are accounted for correctly in the Group books during quarter end and year end closing, and local statutory account.

• Provide training to stakeholders both in finance and to business team on transfer pricing policies and changes in legislation.

• Manage external service providers and liaise with our statutory auditors on TP matters.

**What We Value

**Experience and Education:

• Minimum 10 years experience in industry and/or consultancy with emphasis on working with multinational groups.

• Relevant education such as lawyer, CPA, economist or education from tax administration or any combination thereof.

Skills and Knowledge:

• Excellent understanding and experience in dealing with international taxation and transfer pricing, OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS and local rules and regulations.

• Proven ability to lead complex transfer pricing projects, drive the team to deliver impactful results, and foster a positive, collaborative environment where team members and stakeholders feel engaged and valued.

• Act as an owner with a proactive approach to set directions, drive changes and improvements in transfer pricing practices.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relations with internal stakeholders and teams.

• Excellent communication skills and able to communicate complicated issues in a precise and concise manner.

• Strong team player who can influence others and the ability to work independently.

• Good general accounting/finance skills and experience. Experience with financial systems (ERP, consolidation tools and management reporting tools) is a plus.

• Advanced communication skills, with fluency in English (both verbal and written). Knowledge of the Danish tax system is a plus.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and other MS Office tools.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. To make sure you receive our emails please check your junk/spam folder and add SimCorp to the safe list of your e-mail contacts.

**Please note: Only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

Join us in this role where you’ll support the Warehouse Management Department with standard procedures and processes across warehousing and operations. You'll play a key role in process mapping and implementation, SAP administration, inventory control, forecasting support, and ensuring that equipment and components are accurately managed across warehouse locations. You'll work closely with warehouse operatives, back-office colleagues, planners, and operational stakeholders to maintain efficient and compliant warehouse processes.

**Welcome to Warehouse Management

**You’ll be part of the Warehouse Management team where you, together with your colleagues, will ensure control over components used for Main Components Exchange and Cable Storage in SAP. You’ll make sure that equipment is registered and handled in SAP for both main components and cable storage facilities.

As a team, we value diversity, collaboration, and a non-hierarchical, respectful, and trusting work environment.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• supporting back-office functions in the department with forecasting

• creating and managing work orders for preparing gearboxes for shipment

• ensuring SAP reflects what we actually have on the shelve

• supporting our check-up teams with creating stock transformers in the system

• handling various minor ad hoc administration tasks.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have an educational background in administration or related field (not mandatory)

• are IT literate, with knowledge of SAP or similar ERP systems, as well as the Microsoft Office package

• have professional experience in the offshore wind business (not mandatory but highly valued)

• possess strong organizational and time management skills

• have excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr35,000.00- kr42,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Are you a senior programme professional with deep contextual understanding, strong strategic judgement and the ability to build trusted relationships in complex settings? Do you combine programme leadership with donor engagement, resource mobilisation and a commitment to rights-based, locally led change? Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke (MS) is looking for a Senior Programme Manager to lead and further develop our engagement in Syria and Lebanon.

About the role

You will be MS’s key focal point for a portfolio of three to four Danida-funded country programmes, including MS’s engagement with youth driven partners in Syria and Lebanon. You will hold responsibility for programme quality, strategic development and resource mobilisation across the portfolio. Working across MS and the wider ActionAid federation, you will turn contextual insight and strong partnerships into effective programmes and new funding opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

• Lead MS’s programme engagement and partner dialogue in Syria and Lebanon within the wider Danida-funded portfolio.

• Lead programme planning, implementation, monitoring, learning and adaptation with partners and ActionAid teams.

• Ensure sound grant and financial management, including budgets, risks, disbursements and donor reporting.

• Lead donor engagement, fundraising and the development of new proposals.

• Turn regional political, economic and social developments into strategic advice and programme decisions making sure, that young people are involved and included.

• Represent MS in relevant donor, policy and coordination forums and contribute to advocacy and communications.

Required qualifications

• At least six years’ experience in programme and project cycle management, including five years in a low- or middle-income country and experience from an NGO, civil society organisation or similar setting.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and building trusted partnerships across cultures and locations.

• Strong grant and financial management skills, including budgeting, risk management and narrative and financial reporting.

• Experience with institutional donors and developing high-quality proposals and reports, including for Danida or the EU.

• Strong analytical, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn strategy into action.

• Fluency in Danish and English and willingness to travel internationally for five to six weeks per year.

Desired qualifications

• Direct professional experience from Syria or Lebanon is highly desirable; substantial experience from the wider MENA region will also be considered.

• Professional working proficiency in Arabic.

• Experience with rights-based, locally led programming and the humanitarian–development nexus.

• Experience with young people, social movements, youth activism or campaigning.

Working at MS

You will join an informal, mission-driven workplace with committed colleagues, professional sparring and room to use your expertise. We offer flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, professional development, paid leave between Christmas and New Year and a vegetarian lunch scheme.

Location and employment terms

The position is full-time and based at MS’s office at Fælledvej 12 in Copenhagen. It is a two-year fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, with preferred start in 1 January 2027 or alternatively, 1 February 2027. You will join the International Programme and Partnerships team and report to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships. The role involves approximately five to six weeks of international travel per year. Salary and employment conditions follow the Danish collective agreement and the applicable AC agreement.

How to apply

Apply through our online recruitment system with your CV and a short motivation letter by Tuesday 10th November 2026, at 23:59 CET. First-round interviews will be held in week 48 & second-round in week 49. Questions can be directed to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships, at lpe@ms.dk.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Specialist - Digital Transformation - Viby
jobs.description:
Do you have the AI insight and business acumen to determine which technologies will create the greatest value for Arla in the years ahead?

This is a unique opportunity to lead the AI agenda, driving the transformation from experimentation to scaled adoption of AI, Copilot, and intelligent automation across the business.

“In this role you will influence the future of how more than 20,000 colleagues will benefit from emerging technologies across Arla. Your work will help identify the use cases that bring value, and the governance work you d__o will ensure a safe steer on the journey says Søren Bækgaard Hansen, Senior Director, CIO Office and Data Governance.

How you will make an impact

This role combines hands-on thought leadership with transformation execution. You will operate as a key driver in the CIO Office - shaping how AI is governed and embedded into everyday work.

As our new Senior IT Specialist you will take ownership of the AI governance framework and cross-functional collaboration model, ensuring that AI is used responsibly, effectively, and at scale across Arla. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business zones and functions, external partners, IT and senior leadership and act as a connector between strategy, governance, and delivery teams to drive tangible business value and outcomes.

In this role, you will

• Lead the end-to-end AI governance agenda, including policies, standards, and controls across Agents, Copilot, and automation use cases

• Drive business transformation through AI by identifying opportunities, shaping PoCs and MVPs, defining value cases, and leading the transition from experiments to scaled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Enable adoption of AI by defining clear frameworks, practical guidelines, and reusable patterns for business and IT product teams

• Partner with senior leaders to translate emerging AI opportunities into strategic decisions, roadmaps, and practical actions that create business value

• Facilitate workshops and drive collaboration across platform teams, architects, product teams, and business functions

• Lead communication and storytelling that builds confidence, clarity, and momentum around AI at Arla

What will make you successful

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience driving AI, technology, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex organisation. Ideally, you have worked in a similar role within a large global company. Alternatively, you come from a consulting background where AI, emerging technologies, and business transformation have been a core part of your work.

• Strong understanding of governance, risk, and compliance, ideally in the context of AI or data

• Proven ability to drive adoption and influence without formal authority across multiple teams

• Solid stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage both technical experts and senior business leaders

• A pragmatic mindset – able to translate strategy into initiatives that drives real business value, that can be actionable by our IT & Digital organisation

• Strong communicator with the ability to drive fact-based storytelling and engagement

• Solid understanding of business challenges and opportunities in a large internal cooperation ideally in a FMCG context

• Confident in building business cases that demonstrates tangible business value

What do we offer?

You will join the CIO Office at Arla at a moment where AI is becoming a core capability across the Arla business.

We offer a highly visible role where you will help shape Arla’s AI and Agentic AI adoption journey. You will be part of a collaborative and forward-looking environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand, with opportunities to work with leading partners and technologies. You will also join a culture focused on learning, trust, and making a real impact, while helping define how AI creates value across one of the world’s leading dairy companies.

Application & contact

If you want to seize this exciting opportunity, please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please contact Søren Bækgaard Hansen (sorha@arlafoods.com).

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

We store summer sun for the winter. Now Photoncycle is heading into thousands of Danish homes, and we are looking for a trainee who wants to help build the market from the ground up. Is that you?

About Photoncycle

Solar panels produce plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that problem: we store the energy in a tank in the ground next to the house, so the household can use it for electricity and heating all winter. Surplus power is sold on the electricity market, where it helps balance supply and demand. The household pays a fixed monthly fee, and we build, install and operate the system.

We are 25 employees with offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026 we raised a €15 million Series A led by NordicNinja and Voima Ventures. We are now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, and the first phase of our production plant is underway.

Photoncycle is a completely new technology, and Denmark is our first market.

Why this role

As a trainee, you will be part of building Photoncycle's Danish operations, from research and permit processes to partner dialogues, pilot customers and events. You will work across the full breadth of a market launch and get hands-on experience with how a new energy technology is brought to market in Denmark.

The role is deliberately broad, and the scope will be tailored to the number of hours you work. Tasks will shift as the launch gets closer, and your responsibilities will grow with the role down the line.

What you will do

This is a versatile, hands-on role that mixes research, relationships and the nuts-and-bolts work. You will report to Anne Clara Laugesen, General Manager of Photoncycle Denmark, and work closely with our colleagues in Oslo.

Tasks and responsibility will include:

Market build and operations support

• 
Support our pilot customer programme, from first contact to onboarding

• 
Follow and assist with permit processes and dialogues with municipalities and authorities

• 
Help build and maintain relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders

• 
Take part in preparing test sites and the first installations

Research and analysis

• 
Desk research on municipalities, funding schemes, partners and competitors

• 
Monitor funding and grant opportunities

• 
Collect and structure data and recurring customer questions for internal use

Events and meetings

• 
Practical planning of customer meetings, community events and site visits: invitations, sign-ups, venue, catering and follow-up

• 
Prepare material and logistics for conferences and external events the team attends

What you bring

We imagine you being structured and comfortable juggling many small tasks at once. You take ownership, spot what needs to be done, and ask when something is unclear.

We expect you to:

• 
Be studying, or recently graduated, in a relevant field such as business, energy, engineering, public administration or similar

• 
Write and speak Danish fluently and work comfortably in English

• 
Be confident with Office tools and quick to pick up new systems

• 
Handle confidential information, including customer data, with care

It is a plus if you:

• 
Have an interest in the energy transition, energy systems or the Danish energy market

• 
Have experience from a startup, student job or association work with admin or coordination

• 
Are used to working with AI tools

You don't need to be an energy expert. What matters most is that you enjoy building something new where the right answer isn't known yet – so apply even if you can't tick every box.

What we offer

• 
A front-row seat to building a new energy company in Denmark ahead of a 2027 launch

• 
Close daily collaboration with the GM and real responsibility from day one

• 
Insight into regulation, permits, partnerships and go-to-market in the energy sector

• 
A small, international team with colleagues in Norway

• 
An office in the heart of Copenhagen at BloxHub, with a great lunch setup and free coffee

Start and application

The position can be set up in three ways: as a paid student job (15–37 hours a week), as an internship as part of your studies, or as virksomhedspraktik via your jobcentre if you have recently graduated and are currently unemployed. Hours and tasks are tailored to the arrangement. The start date is yesterday – or whenever you're ready, really.

We will be taking interviews as applications come in.

Photoncycle is committed to an inclusive workplace and hires based on skills, experience and potential. We encourage everyone interested to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnic background, religion or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

_Some games chase trends. Subway Surfers helped define an entire genre.

_Now, we're looking for a UI/UX Designer to help shape what comes next.

This is your chance to leave your mark on one of the biggest mobile games ever made. A game with a massive global audience, instant player feedback, and a team that never settles for "good enough". The challenge? Keeping an iconic game feeling fresh, modern, and innovative for hundreds of millions of players around the world.

Come help evolve the visual experience of Subway Surfers, designing new features, game modes, and player journeys while continuously improving the experience that keeps players coming back. Some days you'll be crafting entirely new interfaces. Other days you'll make a tiny change that unlocks a surprisingly big impact. That's the fun part.

If you enjoy solving creative puzzles, have a knack for details, and seeing your work reach millions of players, then this might just be your gig.

**Responsibilities

**

• Actively refine and improve existing UI/UX to elevate player engagement and satisfaction, ensuring Subway Surfers remains intuitive, modern, and enjoyable to play.

• Design and implement intuitive, engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing features.

• Create UX wireframes, user flows, and prototypes to support feature development and player experiences.

• Help shape the visual direction of the game's interface, evolving and modernizing the experience, while staying true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Ensure a consistent visual style, tone, and user experience across all UI elements.

• Create and maintain UI documentation, design systems, and style guides to support consistency and scalability.

• Optimize UI implementations to ensure smooth performance across a wide range of mobile devices.

Life at SYBO

**In your first month...

**You'll get to know the team, the game, and the players that have made Subway Surfers one of the most successful mobile games in the world. You'll be introduced to our tools, workflows, and ways of working while building relationships across the studio. With support from your teammates, you'll begin contributing to your first projects and quickly find your footing as part of the team.

**Within 3 months...

**You'll start taking ownership of more impactful work across the game, designing engaging interfaces and helping improve the player experience through thoughtful UI/UX solutions. You'll collaborate closely with the team to iterate on designs based on player feedback, insights, and performance data.

**By 12 months...

**You'll be a trusted contributor to the future of Subway Surfers, able to lead individual UI/UX initiatives across major features. At this point, your contributions to the UI style guide and visual framework will have enabled a smoother collaboration across teams, ensuring Subway Surfers will remain an evergreen.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI design work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging player experiences.

• Strong ability to create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and polished final designs that effectively balance player needs and business goals.

• Skilled at designing, rendering, and animating high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Advanced proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Knowledge of conducting user research and translating player insights into actionable design improvements.

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

The role:

As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

Your responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

Your qualifications:

We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

We expect that you will have:

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

It is a distinct advantage if you:

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

Your personal profile:

You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

Why join NNIT:

At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

We offer:

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

About NNIT:

NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

Apply now

If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

A senior legal role with genuine influence

Fertin Pharma is looking for a Senior Group Legal Counsel who combines strong legal judgement with commercial perspective and the confidence to advise at executive level. You will be entrusted with complex, high-impact matters where the legal path is not always defined—and where your ability to set direction, balance risk and opportunity, and turn complexity into decisive advice will directly influence business outcomes.

Reporting to the VP, Head of Legal, Regulatory and QA, you will operate as a senior individual contributor and legal owner across key business areas. Although the role has no direct line management responsibility, it carries a clear functional leadership mandate: you will shape legal strategy, challenge and support senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional initiatives and set standards for how Legal enables the organisation.

Your mandate

• Strategic legal leadership: Develop and implement legal strategies and risk mitigation frameworks for key business areas, aligned with Fertin’s business objectives, group requirements and legal risk appetite.

• Executive and senior stakeholder counsel: Provide expert, commercially pragmatic legal advice to senior management and cross-functional leaders on complex legal, commercial, regulatory, governance and reputational matters.

• Commercial contracts and business support: Own the legal strategy, negotiation approach and risk position for material commercial agreements, including customer, supplier, development, manufacturing, licensing and strategic collaboration arrangements.

• IP and confidential know-how: Lead the legal framework for protecting Fertin’s IP, know-how and confidential information in commercial and R&D collaborations, including ownership, access rights, confidentiality and contractual protections

• Compliance/GDPR: Lead and implement legal compliance and data protection frameworks in relevant areas, including GDPR, confidentiality, sanctions, third-party risk and group policies, in coordination with PMI Legal where relevant.

• Regulatory, quality and product-related legal matters: Act as legal owner for strategic input into regulatory, quality and product-related matters, identifying legal risks and developing practical solutions across functions and jurisdictions.

• Corporate governance: Develop and implement governance processes, powers of attorney, corporate approvals, board/management documentation and internal legal policies to support clear decision-making and accountability.

• Disputes and claims: Lead the legal handling of disputes, claims and settlement strategies, including legal assessment, risk exposure, negotiation strategy and coordination with external counsel.

• Group and intercompany matters: Support legal structuring and documentation for intercompany arrangements, intra-group services and group governance matters, ensuring clear responsibilities and alignment with business, tax and Finance stakeholders.

• Legal processes, templates and standards: Develop and improve legal processes, contract standards, templates, playbooks and ways of working to strengthen quality, efficiency, consistency and risk management across the organisation.

• AI adoption in Legal: Lead responsible use of AI tools within Legal, including identifying use cases, setting governance principles and ensuring confidentiality, quality and legal risk controls.

The senior profile we are looking for

• You hold a Master of Laws, cand.jur., cand.merc.jur. or an equivalent legal qualification.

• You bring at least five years of relevant experience from an international in-house legal function and/or a law firm, with a track record that demonstrates senior-level judgement and ownership.

• You have substantial experience with sophisticated commercial agreements and legal risk management; experience within compliance, governance, IP or regulated industries will be a strong advantage.

• You are comfortable operating where matters are complex, cross-border or ambiguous, and you know when to decide, challenge, involve others or escalate.

• You can move confidently between strategic advice and hands-on execution—from executive counsel and negotiation strategy to drafting, implementation and follow-through.

• You communicate with authority and clarity, build credibility quickly and can influence stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.

• You are commercially pragmatic without compromising legal integrity, and you are motivated by building solutions and standards that last.

Your impact

This role offers the opportunity to influence decisions close to the business, own matters of strategic importance and leave a visible mark on how Legal operates across Fertin Pharma. Your success will be reflected not only in sound legal outcomes, but also in stronger decision-making, clearer risk ownership and legal frameworks that enable the organisation to move forward with confidence.

Interested?

If you are an experienced legal professional who wants more than a traditional advisory role—and are ready to take ownership, influence senior stakeholders and shape the legal agenda in an international and highly regulated environment—we would like to hear from you.

Special Conditions

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates who accept an offer of employment with Fertin. A satisfactory background check is a condition of employment.

The background check is a standard and important part of our hiring process and is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as Fertin’s internal compliance and integrity requirements.

Do you have a passion for robotics and automation? And would you like to see the solutions you work with come to life at customer sites around the world?

At Inwatec, we develop and build advanced automation and robotic solutions for industrial laundries worldwide. We are looking for a Software Commissioning Engineer who enjoys combining software, robotics, and hands-on problem solving.

You will work closely with our engineers in Denmark, but a big part of your job happens where our solutions are put into action: at customer sites around the world.

YOUR TASKS

• Programming and configuring robots, machines PC and PLC systems

• Testing and commissioning systems at customer sites

• Implementing our automation solutions worldwide

• Troubleshooting software, PLC, network and machine-related issues

• Fine-tuning systems to ensure stability and performance

• Supporting customers during installation and start-up by being the ”Face on-site”

• Being co-responsible in cutomer teaching of our system during training and meetings

• Working closely with our software team to improve existing solutions and develop new features through feedback from site

YOUR PROFILE

• You have a degree in robotics, automation, software, engineering or a similar technical field

• You have an interest in programming, robotics, and industrial automation

• You enjoy hands-on problem solving, and seeing your solutions work in the real world

• You are curious, independent, and comfortable taking responsibility on-site

• You are fluent in English and confident communicating with customers and colleagues internationally. Additional language skills, particularly German or French, are an advantage

• Previous experience with PLCs, robotics, commissioning or industrial machinery is an advantage, but not necessarily a requirement

• You have a category B driver's license

• You are excited about travelling. The position includes approximately 100–150 travel days per year, primarily for commissioning at customer sites worldwide

WE OFFER

• A job where you combine software, robotics, and real-world engineering

• The opportunity to follow solutions from testing in Denmark to full operation at customer sites

• International experience through projects around the world, involving travel from a few days to a couple of weeks, and occasionally longer trips with the possibility of a break along the way

• A high degree of responsibility and freedom in your work

• Skilled colleagues within software, automation, and engineering

• Good opportunities to develop both your technical and personal skills

• An informal working environment with short decision-making processes

One week you might be testing a system in Denmark. The next, you could be commissioning a robot on the other side of the world.

If that sounds like the kind of engineering job you are looking for, we would like to hear from you.

INWATEC - THE LAUNDRYNERDS

JENSEN-Group is a global leader in industrial laundry technology, with roots on Bornholm and a strong developmental focus. Inwatec ApS is part of JENSEN-GROUP, and Inwatec develops and produces machines and robots for industrial laundries worldwide. We are a fast-moving company in rapid development and our team is creative and dynamic, with very dedicated employees. We love our informal work environment, where every idea is taken seriously and everybody is treated equally. On Fridays, we meet at our bar for an after-work beer or some ping-pong.

We are looking forward to moving into beautiful new offices on Hvidkærvej, Odense in 2027.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Experience Design transforms complex financial workflows into intuitive solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. We bridge sophisticated investment technology with the people who depend on it — portfolio managers, compliance officers, and analysts operating in high-stakes environments where precision and speed matter.

Our Global Experience Design team operates as a centralized center of excellence with distributed impact. We maintain unified standards and processes globally while embedding designers directly within product teams for deep collaboration and contextual expertise. This lets us stay consistent across SimCorp's product ecosystem while scaling expertise efficiently across markets and time zones.

As Principal Experience Designer, you will serve as the senior design authority for our most complex, strategic initiatives, influence design direction across multiple teams, and mentor senior designers.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead design for SimCorp's most complex and strategic initiatives, contributing to the overall strategic vision and design craft excellence.

• Establish design patterns and standards adopted across the organization, and influence design system evolution and adoption.

• Drive innovation in financial technology user experience, influencing multiple products across the organization.

• Partner with senior product leadership on roadmap planning, and represent the design perspective in architectural and technical decisions.

• Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert in UX.

• Work closely with engineering leadership on technical feasibility, and collaborate with user research on strategic research initiatives.

• Partner with customer success to integrate user feedback, and present design vision to executive stakeholders.

• Work independently and cross-functionally with senior leadership.

• Mentor Lead and Senior Experience Designers, and contribute to hiring decisions for senior design roles.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to — and interested in — learn the rest.

• 8+ years of design experience, with deep expertise in enterprise software.

• Proven track record leading complex, multi-team design initiatives.

• Strong systems thinking and design pattern recognition.

• Ability to navigate between high-level strategy and detailed execution.

• Skill in translating complex financial concepts into clear, actionable interfaces.

• Experience getting the most from AI tools in crafting creative solutions.

• Experience mentoring senior designers and design leaders.

• Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and drive stakeholder consensus.

• Self-directed and results-oriented, taking ownership of projects while contributing to our collective design practice.

• Experience with the fintech domain is a plus.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.
